name: hoja
description: Trebol's TaskManage (acceptance questions + evidence-validated completion), its Swarm task-enforcement hooks and Hoja mode (automatic TaskManage → Hoja issue publication), plus the hosted Hoja API tools — ported 1:1 from cloverinternational/trebol.

hoja_api_url.title: Hoja GraphQL URL
hoja_api_url.description: Hoja (Linear-compatible) GraphQL endpoint, e.g. https://hoja.example.com/graphql. Leave empty to use HOJA_API_URL / LINEAR_API_URL / HOJA_MCP_URL from the environment.

hoja_mcp_url.title: Hoja MCP URL
hoja_mcp_url.description: Hosted Hoja MCP endpoint for the full Hoja API tools (issues, comments, decisions…), e.g. https://hoja.example.com/mcp. Leave empty to use HOJA_MCP_URL, or derive it from the GraphQL endpoint's host.

hoja_token.title: Hoja API token
hoja_token.description: Personal API token. Leave empty to use HOJA_TOKEN / LINEAR_TOKEN from the environment.

hoja_project.title: Default Hoja project
hoja_project.description: Project used when neither the chat (hoja_project select) nor the repository's .pi/config/hoja.json names one.

task_enforcement.title: Task enforcement
task_enforcement.description: block (Trebol default): non-read-only tools are refused until a TaskManage task is in_progress and active. advise: nudge only. off: no gate.
